mapper.select: SELECT kb_id, job_id, actor_ref AS actor, fingerprint, status, snapshot::text FROM nw_knowledge_rebuild_publish_receipts WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND actor_ref=#{actor} AND request_id=CAST(#{requestId} AS uuid)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_knowledge_rebuild_publish_receipts (tenant_id, request_id, actor_ref, kb_id, job_id, fingerprint, status, snapshot) VALUES (#{tenant}, CAST(#{requestId} AS uuid), #{actor}, #{kbId}, #{jobId}, #{fingerprint}, #{status}, CAST(#{snapshot,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb))
